model: 75% XGBoost (Tweedie loss, one model across all products) + 25% weekday-adjusted exponential smoothing per product. Chosen by a model competition of 25 candidates on three real datasets (Nov 2026).

tests.what: 54 stores, 1,782 series, 2 held-out test windows of 16 days (Jul-Aug 2017), never used to choose the model
tests.baseline: TSB, the best classical method tested

tests.what: 3 stores (one per state), 7,452 food and household items, M5's official 28-day test window, never used to choose the model
tests.baseline: TSB, the best classical method tested

tests.what: 3 warehouses, 2,554 fresh-food items (produce, bakery, meat), 2 held-out 14-day windows (May-Jun 2024), days the item sold out not scored
tests.baseline: TSB, the best classical method tested

note: Accuracy = 1 - WAPE (share of units forecast wrongly), weekly totals. Single items sell 0-2 a day, so item-level accuracy is naturally lower. None of these datasets is Indian: Stockora is not yet validated on Indian shop data.
